name: Women of Xal II
source:
The revolutionaries threaten bloody upheaval in increasingly bold moves, old antagonists remain an ominous looming cloud, and every side seems to want Xjena dead. She can't seem to win! But you'll help her get through the hardships, just like you did before~

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/projecttrinity/women-of-xal-ii]Kickstarter[/url]]
